title: Little dragon dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='glow' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#9dff70'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#3bd94a'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M70 72 Q82 66 80 54 Q78 46 88 44' fill='none' stroke='#3bd94a' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- tail spike -->
  <path d='M88 44 L94 36 L90 46 Z' fill='#ff9f43' stroke='#ffcf8a' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- left leg -->
  <path d='M40 76 Q36 86 30 88 Q26 89 28 84 Q31 78 36 74 Z' fill='#2fbf3a' stroke='#8aff70' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- right leg -->
  <path d='M58 76 Q62 86 68 88 Q72 89 70 84 Q67 78 62 74 Z' fill='#2fbf3a' stroke='#8aff70' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='49' cy='62' rx='19' ry='17' fill='url(#glow)' stroke='#c9ffb0' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='49' cy='66' rx='11' ry='10' fill='#f5ffb0' stroke='#fff7c2' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- left arm raised -->
  <path d='M33 56 Q22 48 18 38' fill='none' stroke='#7cff5a' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M18 38 L14 30 M18 38 L22 30' fill='none' stroke='#7cff5a' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- right arm raised -->
  <path d='M65 56 Q76 48 80 38' fill='none' stroke='#7cff5a' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M80 38 L76 30 M80 38 L84 30' fill='none' stroke='#7cff5a' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='49' cy='36' r='15' fill='url(#glow)' stroke='#c9ffb0' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- snout -->
  <path d='M49 40 Q60 42 62 46 Q56 50 48 48 Z' fill='#3bd94a' stroke='#9dff70' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- nostrils -->
  <circle cx='59' cy='45' r='1.4' fill='#ff9f43'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='32' r='3.2' fill='#123c1a'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='32' r='3.2' fill='#123c1a'/>
  <circle cx='45' cy='31' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='31' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M46 41 Q52 44 57 41' fill='none' stroke='#ff7a9c' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- horns -->
  <path d='M38 24 Q34 14 42 16 Z' fill='#ff9f43' stroke='#ffcf8a' stroke-width='1'/>
  <path d='M60 24 Q64 14 56 16 Z' fill='#ff9f43' stroke='#ffcf8a' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- cheek -->
  <circle cx='39' cy='39' r='2.5' fill='#ff7a9c' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- back spikes -->
  <path d='M36 48 L30 44 L37 54 Z' fill='#ff9f43' stroke='#ffcf8a' stroke-width='1'/>
  <path d='M62 48 L68 44 L61 54 Z' fill='#ff9f43' stroke='#ffcf8a' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- sparkles -->
  <path d='M25 20 L27 24 L31 25 L27 26 L25 30 L23 26 L19 25 L23 24 Z' fill='#fff7c2'/>
  <path d='M78 18 L79.5 21 L82.5 22 L79.5 23 L78 26 L76.5 23 L73.5 22 L76.5 21 Z' fill='#fff7c2'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='20' r='1.6' fill='#c9ffb0'/>
  <circle cx='32' cy='16' r='1.6' fill='#c9ffb0'/>
</svg>
